title: Support examples to factorized Mirror context code
hypothesis: An inferred factor-addressed code can represent held-out compositional task functions with a better actual storage/compute/quality frontier than generic CNP-style context aggregation and direct CAVIA adaptation.
fit_policy: Fit shared factor codebook only on the 12 visible combinations. Infer task code from support samples only. Audit data never enter fitting.
storage: Actual serialized inference .npz bytes, including shared predictor, context basis, factor codebook, encoder or solve metadata, indices and schema.
compute: Count support examples, least-squares/nonlinear solve evaluations, active multiply-add proxy and isolated wall time; zero optimizer updates.
success_gate: Both development seeds: held-out nRMSE <=0.05 and a strict improvement over both generic pooled context and direct CAVIA in at least one bytes/compute axis without worse quality, with no regression on another axis at matched quality.
failure_gate: Mirror fails quality or is weakly dominated by either generic control on complete bytes, compute and quality. Fresh remains sealed after any gate miss.
boundaries: Factor identity is not given to encoder
No natural task or language-model claim
